entities.name: Otakar Vindyš
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Otakar Vindyš was a Czech ice hockey defenseman who competed for Czechoslovakia in the 1920 Summer Olympics and in the 1924 Winter Olympics. Vindyš was a native of Prague.
